checks.check_name: Duplicate line items (same business key)
checks.resolution: De-duplicated on (order_id, product_id, quantity, unit_price, discount_pct); lowest line_item_id kept

checks.check_name: Duplicate order records (same order_id)
checks.resolution: De-duplicated on order_id; earliest record kept

checks.check_name: Line items with a missing order_id or product_id
checks.resolution: Line dropped: no key to attribute the sale to

checks.check_name: Line items pointing at a non-existent order
checks.resolution: Line dropped: the order does not exist

checks.check_name: Line items pointing at a non-existent product
checks.resolution: Line dropped: the product does not exist, so it has no category

checks.check_name: Orders pointing at a non-existent customer
checks.resolution: Order dropped: it cannot be attributed to a customer

checks.check_name: Line items with a NULL quantity
checks.resolution: Line dropped: quantity is required to compute revenue

checks.check_name: Line items with a negative quantity
checks.resolution: Line dropped: a negative quantity is a returns artefact, not a sale

checks.check_name: Line items with a zero quantity
checks.resolution: Line dropped: a zero-quantity line contributes no revenue

checks.check_name: Line items with a NULL unit price
checks.resolution: Line dropped: price is required to compute revenue

checks.check_name: Line items with a non-positive unit price
checks.resolution: Line dropped: a non-positive price would create negative revenue

checks.check_name: Line items with a discount_pct outside [0, 1)
checks.resolution: Line dropped: the discount rate is not interpretable

checks.check_name: Stored discount_amount inconsistent with discount_pct
checks.resolution: Recomputed from discount_pct; the stored column is treated as advisory

checks.check_name: Order total does not equal subtotal + shipping + tax
checks.resolution: Components are authoritative; the order total is reported as a variance only

checks.check_name: Completed orders with no valid line items
checks.resolution: Excluded from the eligible-order set: nothing to sell

checks.check_name: Orders with an unrecognised status
checks.resolution: Order dropped: the status cannot be classified as eligible or excluded

checks.check_name: Orders with an unparseable order_date
checks.resolution: Order dropped: it cannot be placed in the observation window

checks.check_name: Orders outside the observation window
checks.resolution: Excluded from the eligible-order set by the window rule

checks.check_name: Orders with a missing customer_id
checks.resolution: Order dropped: revenue cannot be attributed to a customer

checks.check_name: Products with a NULL or non-positive list price
checks.resolution: Product dropped from the catalogue; it cannot carry revenue

checks.check_name: Refund allocation does not sum back to the order refund
checks.resolution: Must be zero: the allocation rule assigns the rounding remainder to the last line

checks.check_name: Customers with a NULL or unparseable registration_date
checks.resolution: Customer dropped from the customer dimension

checks.check_name: Stored is_first_order flag disagrees with the derived flag
checks.resolution: Informational only: the analysis derives first-order status itself
